international.title: ‘Russia wants more than Ukraine,’ Germany’s Merz warns – Europe live
international.summary: German chancellor, in wide-ranging speech, says Moscow is ‘escalating on a massive scale’ Merz goes back to last week’s meeting of the Coalition of the Willing in Berlin, saying the US delegation was “it seemed to me, quite clearly surprised by how united … the Europeans are on this issue.” “It is precisely this determination, ladies and gentlemen, that allows for a cautious optimism regarding the prospect of peace – a genuine peace,” he says. “Anyone who fails to grasp this either does not understand the world as it is, or is pursuing an entirely different agenda – one that stands in opposition to the freedom, openness, and liberal values ​​of our own country.” “It is escalating on a massive scale – including here within our own borders, even at the cost of human lives. That is the situation, ladies and gentlemen. And that is why we, as Europeans, must—and will – set clear boundaries for Russia. ” Continue reading...
